title: Backdoor Mitigation in Decentralized LLM Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decentralized large language model (LLM) fine-tuning lets organizations collaboratively train a shared LLM on data they cannot pool, without a central coordinator. In every round, each node exchanges a trainable adapter with its neighbors over a communication graph, and then aggregates them. This setting, however, is vulnerable to propagated backdoors, which is a hidden behavior that lets a model perform normally on clean inputs but produce an attacker-chosen output whenever a secret trigger appears. We show that a single node poisoning its own model can backdoor adapters of nodes that have never seen a poisoned example, making them refuse prompts that contain a secret trigger. We present Chorus, a decentralized mechanism that lets each node detect and reject backdoored adapters from its neighbors before aggregation, without requiring shared validation data or any knowledge of the attacker's trigger or target. Chorus judges each adapte

translated_title: 去中心化大语言模型微调中的后门缓解
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.37367v1 公告类型： cross。摘要：去中心化大语言模型（LLM）微调使各组织能够在无法汇集数据的情况下，无需中央协调者即可协作训练一个共享的LLM。在每一轮中，每个节点通过通信图与邻居交换可训练的适配器（adapter），然后进行聚合。然而，这种设置容易受到传播性后门攻击——后门是一种隐藏行为，使模型在干净输入上表现正常，但一旦出现秘密触发器就会产生攻击者指定的输出。我们证明，单个节点通过污染自己的模型，就能对从未见过中毒样本的节点的适配器植入后门，使其拒绝包含秘密触发器的提示。我们提出了Chorus，一种去中心化机制，使每个节点能够在聚合之前检测并拒绝来自邻居的后门适配器，而无需共享验证数据，也无需了解攻击者的触发器或目标。Chorus通过……（原文在此处截断）判断每个适配器
tldr: 本文提出Chorus机制，使去中心化LLM微调中的每个节点无需共享验证数据或知晓攻击者的触发器与目标，即可在聚合前自动检测并拒绝邻居传播的后门适配器。
